leadText: Nito (Japanese: ニトウ Nitō) is a character of the day who appeared in Trial on a Golden Scale!.
plainText:
Nito (Japanese: ニトウ Nitō) is a character of the day who appeared in Trial on a Golden Scale!.

==In animation==
===History===
Nito first appeared running away from a that was chasing him. and Goh saved him when Goh defeated it with , allowing Goh to catch it. Nito continued to explore the mine with Ash and Goh, where they came across a batch of s. After getting his to trap Ash and Goh with , Nito revealed himself to be a Pokémon hunter and was preparing to steal the Eggs when two Larvesta attacked, defeating his Galvantula and causing Nito to run.

As Ash and Goh left the mine, Nito and his henchmen stopped them. As they were about to launch an attack, they were stopped by the arrival of Quillon and Danika from Project Mew who were able to defeat their Pokémon with their . Afterwards, Nito and his henchmen were sent to Officer Jenny to be arrested and his Pokémon to be released back into the wild.
